fruit.about: All products, prices and stock levels are fictional. No real sales, payments or deliveries take place.

fruit:orchard-letter.title: A seasonal letter from the orchard
fruit:orchard-letter.summary: A seasonal update from the orchard as the fruit ripens.
fruit:orchard-letter.markdown:
Harvest season has arrived.

Fruit changes with the weather and each variety has its own character. Enjoy trying a few and discover your favorites.

*This letter is from a fictional orchard.*

fruit:citrus-box.title: Early-season mandarin box
fruit:citrus-box.summary: Refreshing sweetness and gentle tartness in a handy box.
fruit:citrus-box.cover_alt: A small box of early-season mandarins
fruit:citrus-box.markdown:
A small box of easy-to-eat mandarins for autumn and winter.

They make a lovely snack during a busy day.

fruit:grape-pair.title: Two-variety grape tasting set
fruit:grape-pair.summary: Compare the sweetness and acidity of two different grapes.
fruit:grape-pair.markdown:
A fictional gift set pairing richly colored grapes with another fragrant variety.

Their beautiful appearance makes them a great seasonal gift.

fruit:pear-assort.title: Fragrant pear assortment
fruit:pear-assort.summary: Seasonal pears with a melting texture and floral aroma.
fruit:pear-assort.markdown:
Enjoy waiting for this assortment of pears to reach its perfect ripeness.

## When to enjoy them

Check the skin and aroma. Once the fruit softens slightly, chill it and enjoy.

fruit:apple-gift.title: Autumn gift box of sweet apples
fruit:apple-gift.summary: Juicy, aromatic apples with a pleasing sweet-tart taste.
fruit:apple-gift.cover_alt: A gift box of bright red apples
fruit:apple-gift.markdown:
A fictional gift product featuring glossy red apples carefully packed in a box.

## Our favorite ways to enjoy them

- Chill and eat fresh
- Slice thinly over yogurt
- Turn leftovers into baked apples

*These products and prices are fictional. No physical goods are sold.*
